newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil shares end higher on year-end buying.
newsitem.headline: Brazil shares end higher on year-end buying.

text.p: Brazilian stocks closed higher on Friday in moderate trade as mostly local investors engaged in some year-end buying to prepare their portfolios for 1997, brokers said.
"This was the next-to-last session of the year," one broker told Reuters. "People were squaring off this year and getting their portfolios ready for next year."
The Sao Paulo bourse's Bovespa index of 49 most-traded shares rose 0.71 percent to end at 70,069 points on turnover of 334.5 million reais ($322 million).
